terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd project && AI_HELPER_API_HOST=0.0.0.0 AI_HELPER_API_PORT=8502 OLLAMA_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:11434 SITES_ROOT=$HOME/.ai-helper/sites HOST_SITES_PATH=$HOME/.ai-helper/sites AI_HELPER_PROJECT=/workspace/project WORKSPACE_ROOTS=/workspace LLM_MODEL=qwen2.5:1.5b FREE_LLM_MODEL=qwen2.5:1.5b FAST_LLM_MODEL=qwen2.5:1.5b LLM_PREFER_FREE=1 .venv/bin/python api.py

terminals.name: streamlit
terminals.command: cd project && STREAMLIT_BROWSER_GATHER_USAGE_STATS=false STREAMLIT_SERVER_SHOW_EMAIL_PROMPT=false OLLAMA_HOST=http://127.0.0.1:11434 LLM_MODEL=qwen2.5:1.5b FREE_LLM_MODEL=qwen2.5:1.5b FAST_LLM_MODEL=qwen2.5:1.5b LLM_PREFER_FREE=1 .venv/bin/streamlit run app.py --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.headless true

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: cd project/web && API_INTERNAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8502 npm run dev
